content:
Hi,

My name is Trung Chau. I am a postdoc in algebra. I am looking for guidance on learning and applying Lean. I would love a chance to contribute to the community.

Best,

Trung.
Is there a particular piece of mathematics that you are interested in formalizing?
I work in commutative algebra and graph theory so i'd be interested in formalizing them
But i am a newbie here so i do not have a good idea on which piece to start, or even how to do it
I also love the Natural Number Game and would love to building more worlds for the game

Welcome!

Might I suggest proving that all the definitions of docs#PerfectField on Wikipedia are equivalent? I'm not sure which ones already exist (I did find docs#perfectField_iff_splits_of_natSepDegree_eq_one in another file) but for example "The separable closure of k is algebraically closed" only has one side of the implication (search PerfectField, IsSepClosure on #loogle).

Trung Chau said:

I work in commutative algebra and graph theory so i'd be interested in formalizing them

Coincidentally, perfect graphs also need some love, but we haven't even defined them yet.
@Snir Broshi can u tell me howto get started? Perfect graphs sound great but i am not sure where to start
@Trung Chau I moved your message here as you accidentally posted it in the wrong topic (an easy mistake to make)
